type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {l : ℕ} [CharZero K]
  {φ : Fin l → K[X]}, (∀ (ν : Fin l), φ ν ≠ 0) → (Function.Injective fun ν ↦ (φ ν).natDegree) → Roth.wronskian φ ≠ 0
what: Nonzero polynomials of distinct degrees have nonzero normalized Hasse Wronskian in characteristic zero.
how: One coefficient equals product of leading coefficients times a binomial determinant; Vandermonde gives nonvanishing.
mathlib_api_audit: Mathlib has binary Polynomial.wronskian, an explicit n-tuple TODO, and generic Matrix.det_vandermonde_ne_zero_iff. All five actual methods searched current/literature/abstract forms; no direct family replacement. Local index unavailable does not prove absence.
moral_duplications: Generic coefficient nonzero and Vandermonde nonzero steps already abstract. Hasse coefficient and binomial conversion bridges remain new mathematical helpers; downstream criterion cannot be used circularly.
generalization: Verified same-parent Field weakening removes global CharZero in favor of cast-degree injectivity. Separately verified expanded CommRing+IsDomain form. No factorial-nonzero premise needed. ZMod2 positive and negative guards; ZxZ zero-divisor guard.
missing_api: N-ary Hasse Wronskian top-coefficient/nonvanishing API, supported by cancellation-free binomial determinant identity.
action: YES-but-generalise-first: /generalise target for cast-degree hypothesis; group with accepted coefficient theorem and coordinate determinant support; /cleanup before upstream Wronskian.lean PR. Sole caller supplies Nat.cast_injective.comp hinj.
